events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Tune In, Turn On, Drop Out... to the Radio
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the Woodstock Festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and music. Which iconic performance defines Woodstock for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the incomparable Elvis Presley. His music continues to define generations and inspire artists worldwide. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track? #ElvisPresley

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, dying six days later.

angles.name: Remembering a Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: 30 years ago, the music world was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. His legacy and influence remain as powerful as ever. Which Tupac track still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world lost a guitar legend when Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: It's 56 years since we said goodbye to the phenomenal Jimi Hendrix. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles 'Abbey Road' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Crossing into History
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your standout song from this legendary record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Chrissie!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Our Kid!
angles.copy: Big happy 54th birthday shout-out to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top tune from Liam's incredible career?

events.title: John Lennon 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1975 in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine All The People...
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and unity. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the day? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It completely changed the game for music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Licence to thrill, indeed. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the extraordinary life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace and love endures. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Go White Album Wild!
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from this legendary double album is on repeat for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incredible talent of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy... forever iconic. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
